system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global land surface coverage at 10m resolution with near-real-time (NRT) land cover predictions derived from Sentinel-2 imagery, updated every 2-5 days.

data_description.records: ImageCollection with high-frequency global land cover predictions
data_description.total_samples: Thousands of images with near-daily global coverage

raster_content.thematic_group: Global Land Use and Land Cover

band_semantics.label: Discrete land cover class with highest probability

data_description.important_note: Dynamic World provides both probability bands (0-1 for each class) and a discrete label band. The probabilistic approach enables uncertainty quantification and mixed-pixel analysis. Near-real-time updates allow monitoring of rapid land cover changes.
analytical_capabilities: Near-real-time land cover monitoring with 2-5 day latency
Probabilistic land cover assessment enabling uncertainty analysis
Rapid agricultural monitoring (planting, harvest, crop rotation)
Urban expansion detection at sub-monthly intervals
Flood extent mapping using flooded_vegetation class
Mixed-pixel composition analysis using probability bands

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Probability values (0-1) for each land cover class, and discrete class labels (0-8) in the 'label' band.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use probability bands for uncertainty-aware analysis or the 'label' band for discrete classification; filter by date range for temporal analysis.

data_description.data_source: World Resources Institute / Google via Google Earth Engine
